selection_disclosure: All pre-V3 matches, opportunities and basis samples are excluded. They paired independently latest venue books and manual approvals were not cryptographically bound to the reviewed rule text.
hypothesis: When two content-hash-certified contracts have a proved payoff relation, a persistent executable probability dislocation can offer either a positive terminal minimum payout or a measurable post-fee convergence exit without requiring sub-millisecond colocation.

identity.approval: Exact Polymarket condition id and Kalshi ticker plus manual review bound to both current rule-document hashes.
identity.rule_change: Any venue rule change invalidates approval until a new manual review records the new hashes.
identity.automatic_title_matching: diagnostic discovery only; never economic evidence

synchronization.clock: local monotonic receive order with source timestamps retained separately
synchronization.pairing: latest causal state from each venue at the decision cut; never search backward for an older aligned pair
synchronization.unsynchronized_rows: stored as grade-F diagnostics; cannot open an evidence episode

execution.entry: walk equal payout quantity through both executable ask books
execution.early_exit: walk both executable bid books and charge all four taker fees
execution.terminal: credit only the statewise minimum payout from the certified relation proof
execution.fee_stress: fees charged again plus one adverse tick on each leg
execution.jurisdiction: paper observation only; the Dublin process must not trade Kalshi

evaluation.null_outcome: No certified active pairs or no post-fee convergence is an acceptable result.
